title: Beijing's Palace Museum Named World's Most Visited
paragraphs: Chinese museums were among the most visited in the world in 2025, with the Palace Museum in Beijing topping the list with 19 million visitors.

This is according to the Themed Entertainment Association's newest Global Experience Index, which found that the world's top 20 museums were visited 161 million times in 2025 — an increase of 5.4% from 2024.

The Palace Museum is in the center of Beijing, and housed in the city's old imperial palaces, also known as the Forbidden City. The museum was opened 101 years ago, and inside it visitors can enjoy traditional Chinese art and relics.

In fact, Chinese museums took 12 places in the top 20. And while the Palace Museum does charge about $6 to $9 for an adult ticket depending on the season, entry to more than 90% of museums in China is now free, making it easier for people to visit them.
For example, number six on the list is the Nanshan Museum in Shenzhen, and it's free to visit. It offers a look at the city's history and local culture, and had 7.5 million visitors in 2025.
The National Museum of China, which is in Beijing, is also free to visit, and took 10th place on the list, with 6.9 million visits.

The most-visited museum outside of China was the Louvre in Paris. It saw around 9 million visits last year — 3.5% growth compared with 2024 — putting it at number four on the list. The Louvre isn't free, though, with tickets costing visitors from outside the European Union around $36.

London's Natural History Museum is free to visit, however, as are many of the British capital's museums. It was number seven on the list — the only museum dedicated to the natural world in the top 20.
